QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_25

question.text: RVPI (Residual Value to Paid-In) of a fund measures:

answer.text: Cumulative cash distributions divided by paid-in capital
The remaining market/fair value of unrealised investments divided by paid-in capital
The management fee accrued but not paid

explanation.text: The Logic: RVPI is the remaining fair / market value of the fund's unrealised investments divided by paid-in capital. Early in fund life RVPI dominates; late in life it trends towards zero as positions are realised. The Trap: Option A is the DPI definition. Option C is mathematically incorrect. Option D is an unrelated fee concept. Note: The residual value used in RVPI depends on the chosen valuation methodology, as flagged by the workbook.
